name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's fascination with motorsport began as a child, spending weekends glued to Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small racing team, cutting his teeth as a data analyst before transitioning into a strategic role. He quickly proved adept at identifying subtle advantages and developing innovative race strategies, even with limited resources.

Maximilian is known for his meticulous preparation and ability to think several steps ahead. He thrives under pressure and has a knack for making bold, calculated decisions that often pay off. His approach is data-driven, but he also trusts his intuition and has a keen understanding of the human element involved in racing. He joined Carlin two years ago, bringing a fresh perspective and a relentless pursuit of improvement to the team's strategic planning.

What sets Maximilian apart is his ability to visualize the entire race scenario and anticipate potential disruptions. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and push the boundaries of strategic thinking, always seeking the edge that can make the difference between victory and defeat.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height and build, with an intense gaze that reflects his focused mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while reviewing race data.
